newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 19 mln Bull shares.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 19 mln Bull shares.

text.p: France will sell another 19 million shares in computer maker Cie des Machines Bull, reducing its stake to some 17 percent, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
Bull said it maintained its forecast of significant growth in 1997 net profits.
The government currently has 30.5 percent in Bull. After the sale, it will have a stake in Bull equal to those of France Telecom, NEC Corp and Motorola Inc.
The price of the sale will be announced by the Finance Ministry after advise by the independent Privatisation Commission.

Bull said it would have between 15 and 20 percent of its shares on the market and would ask for its shares to be listed on the main monthly settlement market of the Paris Bourse, instead its current cash market listing.
At its current market price of 52 francs ($9.17) per share, the state would be able to raise 1.04 billion francs with the sale. ($ = 5.668 French Francs)
